title: Moving an item to a grouped entry shows list rather than previews, highlight does not follow mouse
line: Dragging a file onto a grouped task now opens the window previews, highlights the hovered one and raises that window.
explanation: When something was dragged onto a grouped task, MouseHandler.qml always opened the textual group dialog, ignoring the 'small window previews' setting. Inside that list the drag position was looked up in the DropArea's coordinates instead of the scrolled ListView's, so the wrong entry could be highlighted and the wrong window raised. cwo's open MRs open the previews tooltip on drag-hover instead (keeping the textual list only for users who chose it on click), give the tooltip delegates a drop area that highlights the hovered window and raises it, and map the lookup into the ListView's content coordinates.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/core: allow pinning tooltip

(libplasma !1633 by Christoph Wolk, already merged on master as a5c11b8d7; needed by the plasma-desktop changes and missing from the rig's build)

applets/taskmanager: open tooltip on drag

(cherry-picks of Christoph Wolk's plasma-desktop !4220 '8b9dbb611c map drag&drop lookup to coordinate system' and the first commit of !4221 'deecb590c0 open tooltip on drag', on top of the already-merged 7b9b412e41 'pin the tooltip when clicked with option set' they depend on)

media.caption: Master, grouped tasks set to small window previews: dragging a desktop file onto the Konsole group opens the textual list
With the MRs: the same drag opens the window previews
Dragging across the previews highlights the hovered one and raises that Konsole window (tmp, then ~)
